2026_03_LAC_BUF.headline: Allen’s hot start meets a Chargers team desperate to steady Herbert
2026_03_LAC_BUF.paragraph1: Josh Allen has opened the season in control of Buffalo’s offense, while Justin Herbert takes the Chargers into a difficult road spot after an uneven start. Los Angeles has acknowledged the urgency of the matchup, and Herbert’s protection will be central against a Bills defense that can force him to extend plays. Buffalo is also managing injuries around Ed Oliver and DJ Moore, so Sean McDermott may need Allen to keep creating points even if the supporting cast is not fully intact.
2026_03_LAC_BUF.model_rationale: Buffalo has the stronger quarterback-driven momentum behind Allen, while Los Angeles needs Herbert protected well enough to prevent the Bills from turning pressure into short-field opportunities.
